label: US Kids Golf – Texas state championships
hint: US Kids Golf state-level events held in Texas only (e.g. Texas Fall/Spring State Invitational), for the current and next season. Follow links to the Texas event pages and to any newer season's state schedule; ignore other states.

label: US Kids Golf – regional championships
hint: US Kids Golf regional championships held in Texas or a neighboring state (Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, New Mexico), for the current and next season. Put the city and state in the city field (e.g. 'Horseshoe Bay, TX'). The regional schedule may be a PDF. Ignore regionals in other states.

label: US Kids Golf – World Championships
hint: The upcoming US Kids Golf World Championship events (e.g. the World Championship and Teen World Championship, usually at Pinehurst, NC). Put city and state in the city field. Follow links to the current year's World Championship pages.

label: AJGA – all tournaments
hint: Every upcoming AJGA tournament nationwide. Put the city and state in the city field (e.g. 'Farmers Branch, TX'). Use the tournament's own page link as the url when the schedule shows one. If there's a link to next year's full schedule, suggest it.

label: TGA / Legends Junior Tour
hint: Junior events run by the Texas Golf Association: the Legends Junior Tour (LJT) schedule and TGA junior championships (e.g. Texas Junior Amateur, junior invitationals). Skip adult, senior and adaptive events. If there's a link to the next year's event calendar or LJT schedule, suggest it.
